name: Paintbrush
summary: Decorator's flat paintbrush with wet paint on the bristle tips; for painting, decorating and art scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the brush lies on the floor at y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (about 490 px long); use about 0.3 next to a person

params.name: color
params.note: paint colour on the bristle tips

params.name: anim
params.note: sway = the brush sweeps gently around the ferrule

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror (the paint then sits on the left)

author: krakujs
